scope: Exploratory hardware-snapshot cost estimate coupled with archived noiseless finite-shot detection observations; no physical QPU execution
observation_source: experiment_22_full_finite_shots/raw: first ten frozen main inputs, 30 measurement seeds, calibrated per-input null threshold at alpha=0.005
backend: IBM Brisbane public fake-provider calibration snapshot, last_update_date 2025-02-26; retrieved 2026-10-13, not live backend data
target: Snapshot native ECR, RZ, SX, X, identity and measurement durations and coupling; reset duration also from snapshot
mapping: Initial logical qubits mapped to physical 0..n-1, SABRE routing, seed_transpiler 916, optimization_level=0; fixed symbolic preparation templates bound after compilation; QISKIT_NUM_PROCS=1 fixes SABRE trial count to one, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1; routed unitary compiled once per method/program, then terminal basis rotations and readout are scheduled separately; compiler receives explicit native basis_gates and directed coupling_map from the same snapshot; Target is used for calibrated durations. This avoids a Qiskit Target GateDirection failure; all 46 programs recompiled consistently. QASM-defined ECR instructions are converted to standard ECRGate after operator-equivalence checks, allowing native direction correction.
preparation: Original method structures: product U(theta,phi,0), two-layer brickwork, product U plus inverse QFT; MutTG auxiliary ports fixed to zero
schedule: ASAP schedule for routed preparation+DUT unitary, followed by global basis-rotation and readout stages on final logical mapping; plus maximum calibrated reset duration and default_rep_delay=250 microseconds each shot
reference_cost: Both original and comparison histogram acquisitions charged to match the two-sample finite-shot oracle; original-program circuit is used as representative duration for both, not separate routing of every mutant
panels: Modeled QPU usage time including 2s batched overhead
Measured generation/preprocessing/ordering plus modeled QPU usage
generation_timing: Single-thread, pinned physical CPU, native first seed stream replay; 60-second censoring is sufficient for the largest modeled 60-second window; no mutant execution or device compilation included
no_input_count_budget: Within these time windows, the 250us repetition delay alone ensures fewer than ten complete two-sample XYZ tests. Verify 10*per_input_time > window for every program/method. Thus archived first-ten observations cover the entire cost window without extrapolation or artificial plateau.
metrics: Program-equal cumulative MS(t) and normalized time AUC(0,t); these differ from MS@1 and input-indexed AUC@1-10
excluded_costs: controller overhead beyond listed reset and rep_delay
noise: No Brisbane gate/readout noise is injected into detection outcomes; hardware-noise effectiveness is not established
job_overhead: One batched sub-job per program/method run; approximate 2-second setup added once, following IBM public workload-usage guide. Not one separate job per test.
deep_program_cost_censoring: Grover-10q: full routing was not completed. Unrouted DUT-only fixed level-zero native decomposition with minimum calibrated gate times gives an optimistic critical-path lower bound, excluding preparation/routing/direction/readout/reset. Its comparison lower bound exceeds each displayed horizon. It contributes zero throughout the curve and is included in all 46-program detection averages, but excluded from mean exact input cost. See code/lower_bound.py.
